rationale.oversight-scaling-inversion: Formalizes verification bottlenecks when agent outputs exceed users’ review capacity.
rationale.framework: Provides a reusable recursive requirement-elicitation architecture for coding pipelines.
rationale.built-system: Implements and evaluates the interactive oversight system on web-development tasks.
rationale.agentic: Produces complete PRDs and downstream websites at artifact granularity.
rationale.steering: Shapes requirements and model context before execution, rather than inspecting outputs.
rationale.non-developer: The generating and supervising users explicitly lack software-development expertise.
rationale.method-experiment: A non-expert performs assigned requirement-generation tasks under controlled conditions.
